done_when: tests/test_split_ships.py checks that forge sync writes each shipped file exactly as its source says, without pinned hashes, so a skill edit needs no test change and two skill edits never conflict in that test

findings.body: The expected content for the generated files comes from `sync.files()` and `githooks.shims()`, the same renderers used by `forge sync` (`src/forge/sync.py:235-257`). If a renderer consistently emits an incorrect hook or workflow, both the expected value and the written file change together, so the assertion at line 73 passes. The previous review’s generated-content gap remains. Check these files against an independent source or behavior contract without restoring skill hashes.
findings.title: Not done: tests/test_split_ships.py checks that forge sync writes each shipped file exactly as its source says, without pinned hashes

why: Every change to a shipped skill breaks the pinned hashes in tests/test_split_ships.py and every merge of two such changes conflicts there
